scripts.setup: npm ci && npm --prefix backend ci && npm --prefix frontend ci && npm --prefix backend run db:setup && npm --prefix backend run seed
scripts.start: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names backend,frontend --prefix-colors blue,green "npm --prefix backend start" "npm --prefix frontend start"
scripts.test: npm --prefix backend test && npm --prefix frontend run unit-test && npm --prefix frontend run component-test
